description: Propose the areas the question needs, each read as its own item, and the genome version the paper's positions are on, as written, with its line.. The paper item's output: the reference as written and the areas to read.
name: propose_reading_areas

PassagePointer.description: A pointer into a retrieved document; code copies the paragraph or row it falls in.

document_id.description: The document of a grep hit, a read span or a table row

offset.description: An offset inside the paragraph or row, as grep, read or rows gave it

ReadingArea.description: One area the paper item proposes; it becomes its own reading item.

area.description: What to read for, in the paper's terms: a table's variants, the protein changes of a results paragraph, the rows of one gene

reason.description: Why the question needs this area

views.description: The section, table or document ids from outline_paper that hold it

ReferencePointer.description: The genome version the paper's positions are on, as the paper writes it.

name.description: The version exactly as the paper writes it, such as GRCh37 or TAIR10

passage.description: The paragraph or row that writes it, by document and offset

reason.description: Why the paper's positions are on this version, from the paper

areas.description: Every area the question needs, each read as its own item; empty only when the ids found in code answer it or nothing in the paper does

not_answered.description: When you give no reference or no area: why, in one sentence

reference.description: The reference the paper's positions are on, or null if none is stated
